candidate.content: For a pan target in an environment listing multiple stoveburners, navigating sequentially to stoveburner locations located the target pan on the second inspected stoveburner (stoveburner_2) after the first (stoveburner_1) held only a pot. The pan was then successfully taken into inventory. This demonstrates that inspecting open cooking surfaces can locate cookware targets without needing to search closed receptacles.
candidate.scope: Applies to tasks targeting a pan where stoveburners are present and reachable as admissible actions. Feasibility evidence for finding pans on open cooking surfaces; does not assert this is always faster than other strategies or that pans will never be inside closed containers.

direct_grounding.semantic_fact: Navigating to stoveburner_1 revealed pot_1 but no pan.
The action 'take pan_1 from stoveburner_2' succeeded, acquiring the target pan into inventory.

minimal_global_context: Initial observation listed stoveburner_1 through stoveburner_4 among available locations.
Task instruction required putting a cool pan in countertop.
